contentPattern.structure: tab labels (All/Climbing/Cycling/Skiing/Surfing/Travel) + per-panel adventure listing grid
contentPattern.note: Each panel's content is an adventure listing grid (image + title link + description per item). Grid items visually match cards-article but are panel content, not a nested block.

suitableFor: category/filter tab bars that switch between listing grids
grouping related content into user-selectable panels
reducing scroll by tabbing through filtered subsets of a listing

similarityEvaluation.reason: No existing tabs-based variant in the project. Created new variant from the Block Collection 'tabs' block.

usage.notes: 'Current Adventures' tabbed filter with 6 category tabs; 'All' panel lists 16 adventures, category panels list filtered subsets. moveInstrumentation import/calls removed from vanilla tabs.js since this is a doc (non-xwalk) project and that helper is not present in scripts.js.
